name: ios-ps-locale-yqs8va
goal: Under en_CA, the build can observe services before launch and retire only its own helpers.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Real macOS ps -o lstart= prints Fri 27 Nov under en_CA; a build must observe its services before launch and preserve its exit and output after helpers retire.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The completed-build example inherits runner locale. Exercise a day-first caller in that existing example and require the child to receive the caller locale.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At dacd5b62b1 the en_CA example waited 30.36 seconds and returned a retirement error instead of left=null. Captured by loop record.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: f33b42ea96 pins only the iOS process table read to C. Build child inherits the caller locale and private process identities match processDescendants and processProbes.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same committed test, inputs, assertion, and environment as red passed in the clean snapshot of f33b42ea96. All 9 reported tests also pass under en_CA on both Macs.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
